reviewed_section_hashes.heading: What the guide helps an agency do
A product purchase is only one transition

required_presentation_changes.prior: The buyer's guide organizes inventory, assessment, planning, implementation, maintenance and training alongside acquisition support. It can help a reader understand what services an institution might need and how procurement fits the migration process. The OMB memorandum supplies a separate planning obligation and prioritization context. Neither document demonstrates that a named agency has completed its inventory, placed an order or received a validated implementation. Those are observable actions requiring agency- or system-specific records, not implications of the guidance itself.

It describes services an institution might need and how procurement can support migration. The retained profile of OMB M-26-15 describes a separate planning obligation for non-national-security federal systems; that scope should not be generalized to every federal system. Neither source demonstrates that a named agency has completed its inventory, placed an order or received a validated implementation. Those actions require agency- or system-specific records. This editorial assessment reuses the dated profiles and does not newly verify the documents, later amendments or agency compliance.

readings.title: NIST ARIA: an evaluation method before continuous assurance

reviewed_section_hashes.heading: Read the pilot within its tested scope
What a stronger case would include

required_presentation_changes.prior: An active institutional use case demonstrates use at its stated level, but does not supply a common measure of accuracy, availability, cost or mission benefit. A named deployment needs authorization, monitoring, incident handling and corrective action appropriate to its role. Changes to the model, data or workflow can require renewed evaluation. The useful join is therefore between a particular assessment and the institution responsible for ongoing operation. Without that join, a reader has a methodological resource and a deployment description, but not a continuous assurance history.
required_presentation_changes.replacement: An institutional overview labeling a use case active is an attributed report of use at its stated scope, not independent verification of deployment or continuous operation. The inherited NASA overview does not supply common measures of accuracy, availability, cost or mission benefit. A named deployment needs its own authorization, monitoring, incident handling and corrective actions appropriate to its role. Changes to model, data or workflow can require renewed evaluation. The useful connection is between a particular assessment and the institution responsible for that system's operation. Without connecting records, the reader has a methodological resource and an institutional description, not a continuous assurance history.
